summary: Comprehensive bug fix verification for Zektrix UK Competition Platform. All 4 reported bugs are FIXED and verified. 7/7 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verification complete for all bug fixes.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <tr> cannot be a child of <span>' - minor React hydration issue, doesn't affect functionality

BUG_FIX_1_AUTODRAW_BADGE.description: AUTODRAW badge only appears on instant_win competitions
BUG_FIX_1_AUTODRAW_BADGE.verification: Tesla Model 3 (classic type, cars category) does NOT show AUTODRAW badge. Only instant_win competitions show the badge.

BUG_FIX_2_AUTODRAW_FILTER.description: Autodraw filter correctly filters to show only instant_win competitions
BUG_FIX_2_AUTODRAW_FILTER.verification: Clicking 'Autodraw' filter shows 7 instant_win competitions. Clicking 'Mașini' filter shows only Tesla (no AUTODRAW badge).

BUG_FIX_3_DASHBOARD_TABS.description: Dashboard tabs (Locurile Mele, Istoric, Contul Meu) work correctly without redirecting to home
BUG_FIX_3_DASHBOARD_TABS.verification: All tabs navigate correctly: /dashboard/locs, /dashboard/history, /dashboard/account. Account tab shows form with first_name, last_name, username, phone fields.

BUG_FIX_4_FREE_COMPETITION_DUPLICATE.description: Backend prevents duplicate entries in free competitions
BUG_FIX_4_FREE_COMPETITION_DUPLICATE.verification: Second POST /api/tickets/enter-free with same user+competition returns 400 error with Romanian message 'Ai participat deja la această competiție gratuită'
BUG_FIX_4_FREE_COMPETITION_DUPLICATE.api_test: Created test user, entered free competition twice - second entry correctly blocked

regression_tests.admin_page: PASS - Admin dashboard loads with analytics, users, competitions data

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Console warning about React hydration in History tab (<tr> in <span>). Doesn't break functionality but should be fixed in future cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Created test users with prefix TEST_freecomp_ for duplicate entry testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 bug fixes verified. CompetitionsPage.js line 39-43 correctly checks competition_type === 'instant_win' before showing AUTODRAW badge.
